signals.text: Breakfast Club: Information about Breakfast Club
Unit 4 Musical stories Moving to music with instruction, changing movements to match the tempo, pitch or dynamics and learning that music and instruments can convey moods or represent characters.

Spring 1 South and West Africa Spring 2 Composition to represent the festival of colour (Theme: Holi festival) Learning ‘Shosholoza’ , a traditional South African song, playing the accompanying chords using tuned percussion and learning to play the djembe and some dance moves.

Summer 1 Looping and remixing Summer 2 Musical theatre Learning how dance music is created, focusing particularly on the use of loops, and learning how to play a well known song before putting a dance music spin on it to create their own versions.

Headteacher's Welcome
Our School values and vision:
"Challenge, Achievement, Resilience, Enjoyment"
Wroxall Primary is a small, yet perfectly formed, caring and forward thinking school at the heart of the village of Wroxall, where we welcome all children and families. Every child is known, celebrated and supported as an individual, but is also part of a community of children, families, staff and Governors whose aim is to provide the highest standard of education for all.
We offer an education based on the needs of the whole child, focusing on academic, social and emotional development. Our team of dedicated and experienced staff prioritise the unique needs of each and every child and grow strong and lasting relationships with our children and families.
Our core values of Challenge, Achievement, Resilience and Enjoyment make up our CARE ethos and this is at the heart of all our learning experiences. We plan and create opportunities and experiences to ignite children's love of learning; from trips and visitors, to pets and performances; cooking and crafting to residentials and sports events.
The children are at the heart of all that we do and every moment of their time with us is spent developing a love of learning that will last a lifetime.
We may be a little school, but we have big ambitions for our children and their futures.
We hope that this website will help you to find out about the life of our very special school. The best way to learn more is to come in and see us, look around the school, and see for yourself what we have to offer.
We very much look forward to meeting you.
Tara Hopkinson - Headteacher
